Name: FirstBlood
Announcement: A first kill has been recorded. The audience has been notified. Someone, somewhere, has already made a highlight reel.

Name: Regular
Announcement: Ten retirements processed. You are officially a recurring segment rather than a guest.

Name: Headliner
Announcement: Fifty. Production has moved you to a better time slot. Do not ask which one.

Name: DenverBloodbath
Announcement: Two hundred. There is now a graphic with your name on it. It animates.

Name: RoomService
Announcement: A room has been cleared. The cleaning crew are contractors and they are not happy about it.

Name: ThoroughlyCleaned
Announcement: Five rooms. At this rate we will run out of rooms before we run out of you. Management considers this a problem.

Name: GoingDown
Announcement: A floor is clear. The elevator is not an elevator and the next floor is worse. Congratulations.

Name: Bruiser
Announcement: One thousand damage dealt. The physics are not remarkable but the commitment is.

Name: Sponge
Announcement: Five hundred damage absorbed. Our medical sponsor would like a word. It is not a kind word.

Name: StillStanding
Announcement: Two thousand damage taken and still upright. This is either impressive or a data error. We are running it as impressive.

Name: Autodidact
Announcement: A skill has improved through use. The old way. The slow way. The way that sticks.

Name: Practised
Announcement: Ten ranks earned the hard way. Nobody taught you any of that.

Name: MovingUp
Announcement: A level. Your contract has been renegotiated in your absence and without your input.

Name: Established
Announcement: Level five. You have a demographic now. They are loyal and slightly concerning.

Name: FreeClimber
Announcement: Ten metres of unassisted climbing. No rope. No sponsor. No sense.

Name: Mountaineer
Announcement: One hundred metres climbed. The rock is starting to take it personally.

Name: Introductions
Announcement: A fist has been bumped. Alliance logged. The audience enjoys this more than the fighting and nobody knows why.

Name: Networking
Announcement: Four alliances. You are building something down here. Production is monitoring it with interest.

Name: Setback
Announcement: A crawler has died. This has been logged as content. Your sponsors are reviewing their position.

Name: Persistent
Announcement: Five deaths. The audience has grown fond of the sound. We have isolated it for the remix.

Name: EstateSale
Announcement: Five bodies and boxes emptied out. Everything in this dungeon used to belong to someone. Now it belongs to you.

Name: AssetRecovery
Announcement: Thirty containers cleared out. Repossession is, when you get right down to it, a two-way arrangement.

Name: WelcomeAboard
Announcement: You have entered the World Dungeon. Your consent was implied by your feet.

Name: PropertyDefacement
Announcement: Your tag is on the cage. The Lucky Tuesday has not been vandalized by a living person since 1893. The chat would like to thank you personally.

Name: ProofOfSummit
Announcement: Your tag is on the top of Fourteener. The mountain has been informed. It does not care. Everyone else does.

Name: OnTheBoard
Announcement: The house paid twenty-five tickets. Someone in the booth wrote the name on a card.

Name: HotTable
Announcement: One hundred tickets, out of the pit and into a pocket. The floor manager is smiling. That is not a good sign.

Name: TheRoomNoticed
Announcement: Five hundred tickets. Casino Cascade has started introducing them as a regular. They did not agree to this.

Name: AgainstTheHouse
Announcement: A table lost. The audience made a noise. The house will remember the noise.

Name: RegularAtThePit
Announcement: Ten hands, taken off the house. June has stopped explaining the rules.

Name: TheLoudOne
Announcement: One spin paid fifty or more. The wheel is still moving in the replay. So is the chat.
